title: Fork
description: Execution-lineage relationship created when a new run starts from an existing checkpoint.

fork_id.description: Stable relationship identifier: fork- followed by lowercase SHA-256 hex.

fork_of.description: Source checkpoint_id used to initialize the new run.

new_run_id.description: Identifier of the newly created execution run.

reason.description: Human- or machine-readable reason for creating the new lineage.

fork_kind.description: Optional machine-readable classification of the fork.
